verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents proxy routing as a core anti-block feature: a premium_proxy flag to get past hard-to-scrape sites, country_code geolocation, a stealth_proxy tier, a proxy-mode transport, and auto mode that escalates through configurations until one succeeds. Its session_id parameter, which pins requests to one IP, implies requests otherwise go out from varying IPs. missing for 10: an explicit statement that the default pool rotates IPs per request, any detail on pool size or IP types, and independent or hands-on confirmation that rotation avoids blocks.
